query: UPDATE central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work SET retry_attempt = retry_attempt + 1, retry_not_before = clock_timestamp() + $4::interval, failure_class = $5, failure_reason = $6, claim_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND workspace_id = $2 AND work.delivery_state = 'claimed' AND work.claim_token_hash = $3 AND work.retry_attempt < 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs AS epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $7) RETURNING retry_attempt
